name: Sys Stats AI
description:
System stats in the top bar with live gauges and graphs, plus your Claude plan usage limits.

Shows:
- CPU usage, clock, per-thread load and temperature
- GPU usage, clock, VRAM and shared memory (AMD)
- Memory and swap
- Battery level, power draw, time left and health
- Claude plan usage (optional, off by default): your 5-hour session and weekly limits with reset times. Requires a Claude Code login on this computer; reads its saved login and contacts only api.anthropic.com.

The menu has gauges, a CPU thread view and a 3-minute graph in collapsible groups that show a one-line summary when collapsed. Choose which items appear in the top bar. On Lenovo IdeaPad laptops it also adds a switch to stop charging at about 80%.
